long_biography.plain_text:
Raised within a Brussels building dynasty established in 1919, Philippe Gillion became part of the fourth generation guiding the family contractor. That background supplied practical knowledge and an established industry platform, but his defining independent venture was Macan.Group, which he created in 2012 as a developer and investor.

Macan grew from opportunistic property deals into an integrated business covering development, investment, management and brokerage across Belgium and Morocco. Gillion later moved day-to-day leadership to a chief executive while remaining executive chairman and a director through his own management company. Beyond business, he and his wife, Miene, funded the restoration of Juliaan Lampens's Woning Van Wassenhove, helping preserve the modernist house for exhibitions and artist residencies.
long_biography.html:
Raised within a Brussels building dynasty established in 1919, Philippe Gillion became part of the fourth generation guiding the family contractor. That background supplied practical knowledge and an established industry platform, but his defining independent venture was Macan.Group, which he created in 2012 as a developer and investor.

Macan grew from opportunistic property deals into an integrated business covering development, investment, management and brokerage across Belgium and Morocco. Gillion later moved day-to-day leadership to a chief executive while remaining executive chairman and a director through his own management company. Beyond business, he and his wife, Miene, funded the restoration of Juliaan Lampens's Woning Van Wassenhove, helping preserve the modernist house for exhibitions and artist residencies.
